# EV Body Parts

> EV Body Parts (evbodyparts.sg) sells body parts for China and EV cars in Singapore, to workshops and car owners. Body parts for China & EV cars in Singapore.

## Facts
- Name: EV Body Parts
- Website: https://evbodyparts.sg/
- Sells: body parts (bumpers, lamps and lights, mirrors, body panels, grilles and trims) and some other parts for China and EV cars
- Serves: workshops and car owners in Singapore
- How it works: search by car, part or OE number, then request a quote on WhatsApp. No online checkout. Fitment is checked (build date, market, trim, OE number) before quoting.
- WhatsApp: +65 8997 6612
